Hundred Swords.name: Hundred Swords
Hundred Swords.summary: A Hundred Swords is a fantasy based strategy game with a medieval tone, developed by Smilebit initially for the Sega Dreamcast, and later released for the PC.

Star Gladiator 2 - Nightmare of Bilstein.name: Plasma Sword: Nightmare of Bilstein
Star Gladiator 2 - Nightmare of Bilstein.summary:
Plasma Sword: Nightmare of Bilstein is a 3D weapon-based fighting video game released by Capcom for the arcades.
It is the sequel to Star Gladiator and runs on the ZN-2 hardware, an improved version of PlayStation-based ZN-1 hardware its predecessor ran on. A Dreamcast port was released in 2000.
